description: This file defines CLI command registration logic for the OpenClaw project, including command entries, conditional registration, and lazy loading of subcommands.

classes.name: SubCliDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for a sub-CLI command, including name, description, subcommand presence, and registration function.

methods.name: shouldRegisterPrimaryOnly
methods.description: Determines if only the primary command should be registered based on environment variables and arguments.

methods.name: shouldEagerRegisterSubcommands
methods.description: Checks if subcommands should be registered eagerly based on environment variables.

methods.name: loadValidatedConfigForPluginRegistration
methods.description: Loads and validates the OpenClaw configuration for plugin registration.

methods.name: getSubCliEntries
methods.description: Returns the list of sub-CLI command descriptors.

methods.name: registerSubCliByName
methods.description: Registers a specific sub-CLI command by its name.

methods.name: registerLazyCommand
methods.description: Registers a sub-CLI command lazily, deferring its import until needed.

methods.name: registerSubCliCommands
methods.description: Registers all sub-CLI commands, either eagerly or lazily based on configuration.
